card.text: K dwarf in Sextans that hosts the hot Jupiter WASP-43b.

introduction.text: WASP-43 is a K dwarf 87 parsecs away, two-thirds the Sun's width. Its giant planet WASP-43b circles it every 19.5 hours.

shape.title: Sphere of the measured radius
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size in neutral gray. No picture of the surface is cast here.
